summary.method: Archive eth_call OffchainFractions.getFraction sampled at create, each day in the final 7d before expiration, near-expiry, and latest. Universe = all FractionCreated events pulled from mainnet logs.
summary.note: completion_rate_given_gate is the primary metric: among terminal fractions that at some sampled time satisfied the 90%/7d gate, what share eventually reached minSharesToRaise.
